'''Narl Gorjax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and served as an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Barnab Chistor]], the political leader of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
 
==Biography==
Narl Gorjax was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], residing in an apartment building on the fourth floor of a middle income district of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]]. Gorjax became the most
senior [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to Gadrin's political leader, [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Barnab Chistor]].<ref name="Halves" />
 
Circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> Governor Chistor's son [[Cavin Chistor]] proposed several criminal individual as nominees to run a [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] under development in Gadrin, in an effort for the [[Syndicate]], a criminal concern operated by Cavin Chistor and his associate [[Dexx Molay]], to control trade at the new port. Gorjax challenged the nominations due to the nominees' criminal links however Cavin urged him to drop the matter and to instead focus on other political priorities. Gorjax refused to drop his complaint and raised his concerns regarding the suitability of the nominations with Governor Chistor. Molay approached Gorjax and proffered a {{Cr}}2,500 for the aide to cease challenging the nominations but Gorjax again refused to back down and instead started to investigate links between Cavin Chistor and Molay.<ref name="Halves" />
 
Eager to end Gorjax's threat to their plans, Chistor and Molay hired the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Varin Teska]] to take out Gorjax. Three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after Gorjax's rebuff of Molay, the aide accompanied Barnab Chistor and the rest of the governor's entourage to the Gadrin glitz club [[Star Shocked]]. There, Gorjax was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by Teska via a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt to the chest, in a hit staged to appear as a failed attempt on the life of Barnab Chistor. A [[Heroes of Cularin|group of freelance agents]] subsequently investigated Gorjax's death and uncovered Cavin Chistor and Dexx Molay's conspiracy.<ref name="Halves" />
 
==Behind the scenes==
Narl Gorjax was created by [[Lee Pickler]] and appeared in the [[2002]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Blinking Eyes: Halves]]'', part of the [[Blinking Eyes trilogy]] of [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] roleplaying campaign.
